WELCOME ABOARD

A great start.
One step at a time.

Ten practical things to try on your first day.
Build confidence with your laptop and workspace.

Use fictional content. Your progress stays in this browser.

DELL PRO · THINKPAD · LENOVO DOCK

One cable.
Many options.

Your screens, sound and accessories, together.
Make your workspace comfortable from day one.

Do these once at a new desk. Use the approved equipment and settings available to you.

01

Give each screen a job

Connect your dock. Press Win + P and choose Extend for separate work areas; choose Duplicate when you need the same view on both.

Open Settings → System → Display → Identify. Arrange the screen rectangles to match your desk, then apply.

Microsoft: multiple displays ↗
02

Check where your sound goes

A dock or monitor can become an audio output. Use Win + A and the sound output selector to choose your headset.

Check your microphone separately in Settings → System → Sound → Input and in your meeting app before your first call.

Microsoft: selecting output and input ↗
03

Make text easy to read

Use Settings → System → Display → Scale to enlarge the overall interface. For just text, try Accessibility → Text size.

Need a quick closer look? Win + + opens Magnifier; Win + Esc closes it.

Microsoft: make Windows easier to see ↗
04

Get comfortable away from the dock

Two fingers scroll. Three fingers switch apps or show your windows. Review Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Touchpad for the actions configured on your laptop.

ThinkPad Fn/Ctrl placement and function-key behaviour vary. Check the key labels if F2 or PrtScn needs Fn.

Something missing or managed?

Ask the service desk. Shortcut support depends on Windows build, apps, hardware and policy—not the laptop’s 32 GB of RAM.
